messages:
asha: Hello team — PR #2618 adds a migration appendix (Hosted->Private) and updates a couple SDK snippets pinned by downstream repos. Preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2618. Assigning @marco for tech review and @rachel for editorial. CI currently failing (linkcheck + vale + markdownlint).

ci-bot: CI report for PR #2618 — failing checks: linkcheck, vale, markdownlint. Use /retest after fixes.

asha: Copying the failing output for easier triage:
```
LINKCHECK FAIL: /docs/migration/hosted-to-private-appendix.md -> broken link: https://kb.redwood-inference.com/setup-private-v1 (404)
VALE FAIL: docs/migration/hosted-to-private-appendix.md:33 — VALE[Precision] 'we' usage flagged (avoid first-person plural in docs)
MARKDOWNLINT ERROR: docs/migration/hosted-to-private-appendix.md: sdk snippet fence missing language (``` instead of ```python)
SPELLCHECK NOTICE: 'onprem' -> consider 'on-prem' or 'on premise'
```

marco: I'll take the link. That KB was moved to /setup/private (no v1). Better to reference the canonical KB path. I'll add a short inline snippet instead of manual redirect to external partner content.

rachel: I'll remove 'we' and switch to second-person. Also add `python` to the code fence and run a quick style pass.

asha: Note: the SDK snippets are functionally identical but the pinned sample in ops-repo references exact formatting. If we change whitespace/formatter it might break their pin. Can we do minimal edits?

support-bot: FYI: add KB cross-ref in PR body so Support can link it when triaging customer migration questions.

marco: Pushed a small commit to replace the KB link with canonical path and include a short networking snippet. Commit: 5e9b7a3.

docs-bot: Pull request updated — new commit 5e9b7a3 by marco. Docs preview rebuild queued: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2618

ci-bot: Docs preview completed — linkcheck PASS, markdownlint FAIL (1), vale FAIL (1).

rachel: The remaining markdownlint is the code fence language (I missed one fence in the 'advanced' section). I'll push a tiny fix and normalize the snippet formatting to keep the pinned content structure identical (no functional changes).

docs-bot: Pull request updated — new commit a2c4f1d by rachel. Docs preview build started: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-2618

ci-bot: Docs preview passed — all checks green.

asha: All green. Plan: merge during today's 15:00 PT docs merge window unless there are objections. Reminder: mention snippet pin in PR description and add the KB cross-ref for Support.

marco: Tech LGTM — small docs-only changes and snippet formatting preserved.

rachel: Style LGTM. Removed first-person and fixed clarity nits.

asha: Merging at 15:00 PT (squash). If anyone on Support needs to follow up about the snippet pin, ping me and I'll coordinate the downstream update. Thanks! :raised_hands:

docs-bot: PR #2618 merged by asha (squash). Change note: docs(migration): add Hosted->Private appendix, update SDK snippet formatting, update KB link. KB: https://kb.redwood-inference.com/setup/private

support-bot: Noted — posting a short alert to #support-ops about the KB path change and snippet pin. End thread.
